findings.issue: The IPV4 guard (one to three digits, four times) accepts octets above 255 (e.g. 999.1.1.1, already in ClientIpTest#fallsBack); the JDK does not parse that as a numeric literal, so InetAddress.getByName (line 64) treats it as a hostname and issues a DNS query, breaking the design's 'never does a DNS lookup' guarantee for a client-controlled header.
findings.fix: Validate each octet <= 255 before getByName, or build the 4 bytes and use InetAddress.getByAddress; add a test proving no lookup.

findings.issue: Test volume is disproportionate: four classes with distinct @TestPropertySource each boot their own Spring context for 1-4 tests; three exist only for AC-9, although ReferralService reads properties.getReferral() per call.
findings.fix: Fold AC-9 cases into ReferralAbuseConfigIntegrationTest by mutating the UserProperties.Referral bean in try/finally; removes 3 contexts and about 120 lines.

findings.issue: Redundant or assertion-free tests: schemaExists, purgeNoOp (no assertion), propertiesBind (duplicates Config#binds except toString/salt), refusalTextIsGeneric (duplicates MVC#refusalBodyIsGeneric), DisabledChecks#existingRulesStillApply (duplicates existingRulesUnchanged).
findings.fix: Drop them; keep the salt/toString assertion in one binding test.

findings.issue: retentionFromConfig ends with an unrelated hash-length assertion and does not check claim-hash nulling under the configured retention.
findings.fix: Remove it; optionally assert a 2-day-old claim's hash is nulled while the row remains.

findings.issue: UPDATE of referral_codes.created_at has no WHERE clause and ages every code in the shared test database; would make TOO_NEW tests flaky under parallel execution.
findings.fix: Scope it to the test's two users.

findings.issue: Durations not validated: negative values are not treated as disabled; sub-second values pass isZero() but become 0 via toSeconds(), so the check runs and never refuses. Not reachable with documented values.
findings.fix: Validate non-negative, or treat toSeconds() <= 0 as disabled.

findings.issue: IPv4-mapped IPv6 (::ffff:1.2.3.4) resolves to Inet4Address and matches the plain IPv4 address; arguably correct, but undocumented against AC-15.
findings.fix: Document mapped addresses as IPv4 in a comment or test.

summary: Approve: every AC met, no blocker or major. The change follows the accepted design; claim order, rollback on refusal, HMAC hashing, V5, JobLock retention, deletion cleanup and all CTO conditions are correct. Main code issue: IPv4 octets above 255 reach InetAddress.getByName and trigger a DNS lookup. Test volume is heavy but hides no gap; consolidate the three AC-9 context classes and drop redundant tests. (Stored by the CEO; regex text in finding 1 is described in words because shell escaping corrupted it on the first write.)
